name: Hydroxyzine
metabolism: Alcohol dehydrogenase forms cetirizine by oxidation; CYP3A4/5 also participates in metabolism. Cetirizine is an active antihistamine and is eliminated substantially through the kidneys.
summary: Hydroxyzine is a first-generation piperazine antihistamine used to treat itching, anxiety, insomnia, and nausea. It can be taken by mouth or given by intramuscular injection.
